messages:
Maya (CSM): Weekly account health sync — want to focus this thread on follow-ups for repeat incidents. BeaconHealth had 3x 503s Mon–Wed, AtlasPay saw latency spikes during nightly batches. Can we call out owners and next steps?
Olivia (Support): Tracing BeaconHealth now. Looks like KV cache eviction during bursty batch windows. Temp mitigation: increased cache TTL for their pool. Patch to adjust batch commit ordering queued. Owner: @Olivia. ETA Wed EOD. /cc @Liam for infra validation. :white_check_mark:
Liam (SRE): I can run a canary of the patch tomorrow 09:30 PT. Need a small traffic window (5–10% traffic). @Maya can you confirm acceptance window with the customer? I'll capture perf traces and heap profiles during canary.
Olivia (Support): Logs excerpt that correlates with the 503s:
```text
2026-02-15T10:12:03Z ERROR kv_cache_evicted key=batch-123
2026-02-15T10:12:03Z WARN request_timeout route=/generate status=503
```
This lines up with cache thrashing.
Sam (AE): Heads-up — BeaconHealth renewal in ~6 weeks. This pattern could increase renewal risk if not communicated proactively. I can schedule an SLO review and mitigation briefing once we have the canary plan.
Jenna (PM): I'll own the postmortem and runbook updates after patch verification. Draft action items: 1) add regression test for batch commit ordering; 2) tune monitoring alerts for cache eviction rate; 3) add runbook steps for TTL rollback. Draft ETA: Thu COB.
Maya (CSM): Ownership: Olivia -> mitigation & patch, Liam -> canary + infra validation, Jenna -> postmortem & runbook, Sam -> customer comms/renewal outreach. I'll draft a short customer-facing one-pager and share by Fri noon. Thanks everyone :pray:
IncidentBot: deploy-bot: Patch build #442 queued for canary. Status: queued -> scheduled 2026-02-19T09:30:00Z
Olivia (Support): Quick note on AtlasPay latency: nightly embedding jobs are spiking vector store I/O. Short-term options: reduce batch concurrency or suggest Dedicated pilot for heavy nightly workloads. I'll run a cost/delta estimate for both.
Sam (AE): Please include the estimated delta and runtime savings. If Dedicated reduces costs >15% and meets latency SLOs, we can propose a pilot in the renewal discussion.
Maya (CSM): Next check-in: Fri 15:00 PT to confirm canary outcome. If canary looks good, Jenna starts the postmortem. If not, we'll escalate to oncall rotation and consider immediate rollback. Closing action list: Olivia (patch + tests), Liam (canary + traces), Jenna (postmortem draft), Sam (renewal comms).
